description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/anisotropic_diffusion_2d_periodic.esm (model AnisotropicDiffusion2DPeriodic, test mms_steady_anisotropic_periodic) at the problem's default resolution (NX=NY=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the second-order centered periodic MIXED second-derivative rule central_Dxy_periodic (the d^2u/dx dy off-diagonal of a positive-definite anisotropic diffusion tensor K=[[1,1/2],[1/2,1]]) together with the diagonal central_D2x_periodic + central_D2y_periodic that make the combined operator dissipative. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
